paper.span_text:
\paragraph{Explicit computation and bit lengths}

One penalty solve uses $O(N(K+1)(M+1))$ rational operations and
$O(N(K+1))$ stored actions and mean-value records.  There are at most
$J_{\rm bis}+2$ solves.  The calibration uses
$O(Q(M+1)^2)$ rational updates, summing the widths of the separate
birth--death walks; it is done once.  Thus the output is compact in these
displayed numerical parameters, with no exponential history tree.

Let $L$ bound the bit length of menu probabilities, menu costs, and input
fees.  The product of their denominators has $O((M+1)L)$ bits.
Depth-$N$ policy probabilities and mean costs have denominator bit length
$O((N+1)(M+1)L)$, with multiplier bits added for penalty objectives.
Numerators additionally count value magnitudes and the bit lengths of
$N,K$.  The calibration denominator has $O(Q L_\gamma)$ bits, where
$L_\gamma$ is the channel input length.  Initial mixture probabilities
add endpoint and $\delta$ bit lengths.  Subtracting rational endpoint
risks does not introduce an exponential number of bits.

The positive difference $\zeta_f-\delta$ is at least the reciprocal of
$2^N$ times the denominator of $\delta$; hence
$\log(1/(\zeta_f-\delta))=O(N+L_\delta)$ when it is positive.
The bit length of a very small positive $f$ is counted in $b_f$.
For fixed rational $\gamma$, $t_0,M,Q,J_{\rm bis}$ and the foregoing bit
costs are polynomial in explicit $N$ and remaining input lengths.
For variable-precision $\gamma$, dependence on numerical $1/\gamma$ is
displayed; polynomial dependence on $\log(1/\gamma)$ is not asserted.
Exact rational coins can be sampled with ordinary private randomness;
they consume no native observation or correction call.

primitive_ops.span_text:
def Cell.bits : Cell → ℕ
  | .natural value => 1 + natBits value
  | .rational value => 1 + ratEncodingBits value

inductive NatOp where
  | add | subtract | multiply | divide | modulo
  deriving DecidableEq

def NatOp.eval : NatOp → ℕ → ℕ → Option ℕ
  | .add, a, b => some (a + b)
  | .subtract, a, b => some (a - b)
  | .multiply, a, b => some (a * b)
  | .divide, a, b => if b = 0 then none else some (a / b)
  | .modulo, a, b => if b = 0 then none else some (a % b)

inductive RatOp where
  | add | subtract | multiply | divide
  deriving DecidableEq

def RatOp.eval : RatOp → ℚ → ℚ → Option ℚ
  | .add, a, b => some (a + b)
  | .subtract, a, b => some (a - b)
  | .multiply, a, b => some (a * b)
  | .divide, a, b => if b = 0 then none else some (a / b)

List.replicate 5 .instructionWordRead ++ List.replicate 4 .addressArithmetic ++
    [.decode, .pcArithmetic] ++ instruction.operations

def primitiveTrace (program : Program) (trace : List State) : List Primitive :=
  trace.flatMap fun state => ((program[state.pc]?).map Instruction.primitives).getD []

/-- The trace consists of actual successive machine states, including the
final fetched halt. Invalid fetch/type/division termination is not success. -/
def Runs (program : Program) (input : List Cell) (trace : List State) (final : State) : Prop :=
  trace.head? = some initial ∧
    trace.IsChain (fun before after => step program input before = some after) ∧
    trace.getLast? = some final ∧ program[final.pc]? = some .halt ∧ final ∈ eval program input

/-- Coded fetch, complete runs including HALT, and exact actual fetched
primitive-trace correspondence are all conclusions to prove. Merely naming
solver labels or counting host Array iterations cannot discharge this target. -/
def CodeRefinementClaims : Prop :=
  (∀ instruction : Instruction, Instruction.decodeWords instruction.encodeWords = some instruction) ∧
    (∀ (program : Program) (pc : ℕ), fetchInstruction (encodeProgram program) (5 * pc) = program[pc]?) ∧
    (∀ (program : Program) (input : List Cell) (state : State),
      codeStep (encodeProgram program) input (codeState state) = (step program input state).map codeState) ∧
    (∀ (program : Program) (input : List Cell) (trace : List State) (final : State),
      Runs program input trace final → CodeRuns (encodeProgram program) input (trace.map codeState) (codeState final)) ∧
    (∀ (program : Program) (trace : List State),
      codePrimitiveTrace (encodeProgram program) (trace.map codeState) = primitiveTrace program trace) ∧
    ∀ program : Program, (encodeProgram program).length = 5 * program.size

def workingCells (state : State) : ℕ := state.live.card + registers.length + state.output.length

noncomputable def stateCellBits (state : State) : List ℕ :=
  (registers.map fun register => (state.register register).bits) ++
    (state.live.toList.flatMap fun address => [natBits address, (state.heap address).bits]) ++
      state.output.map Cell.bits ++ [natBits state.pc]

def peakCells (trace : List State) : ℕ := (trace.map workingCells).foldl max 0
noncomputable def peakOperandBits (trace : List State) : ℕ := (trace.flatMap stateCellBits).foldl max 0
def time (program : Program) (trace : List State) : ℕ := (primitiveTrace program trace).length

/-- The raw input includes exactly original N,K,gamma,delta,c,f. Derived
certificate integers, endpoints, calibration values, tables and traces are
ABSENT. A single uniform preparation program must compute them. -/
def rawInput (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) : List Cell :=
  [.natural P.certificate.stages, .natural P.tools, .rational P.certificate.gamma,
    .rational P.certificate.risk, .rational P.reviewFee, .rational fee]

def preparedInput (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) : List Cell :=
  rawInput P fee ++ [.natural P.certificate.t0, .natural P.certificate.M,
    .natural P.certificate.E, .natural P.certificate.Q, .natural (P.bisectionBudget fee),
    .rational P.Lambda, .rational (P.zeroChargeRisk fee)]

/-- This per-solve readonly cache is charged once by the full core program,
whose own input has no endpoint data. It is not a free endpoint oracle. -/
def solveInput (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee penalty : ℚ) (n k : ℕ) : List Cell :=
  [.natural n, .natural k, .natural P.certificate.M, .rational fee, .rational penalty] ++
    encodeList encodeEndpoint P.endpointCache.toList

def calibrationInput (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : List Cell :=
  [.natural P.certificate.M, .natural P.certificate.Q, .rational P.certificate.gamma] ++
    encodeList encodeEndpoint P.endpointCache.toList

actual_solve_calls.span_text:
structure RoutineLabels where
  solveEntry : ℕ
  solveReturn : ℕ
  endpointEntry : ℕ
  calibrationEntry : ℕ

def entryCount (pc : ℕ) (trace : List State) : ℕ :=
  (trace.filter (fun state => state.pc == pc)).length

/-- These requests are read from real reached RAM registers at a real code
entry address. They are separate from the primitive-time measurement. -/
def actualSolveRequests (labels : RoutineLabels) (trace : List State) : List ℚ :=
  trace.filterMap fun state => if state.pc = labels.solveEntry then (state.register .total).rat? else none

def heapSegment (state : State) (base count : ℕ) : List Cell :=
  (List.range count).map fun offset => state.heap (base + offset)

/-- Every actual solver entry has a real return with the exact original
table in live heap cells. A label alone never certifies a solve or its cost. -/
def SolverCallRefinement (program : Program) (labels : RoutineLabels)
    (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (constant : ℕ) (states : List State) : Prop :=
  ∀ index state, states[index]? = some state → state.pc = labels.solveEntry →
    ∃ multiplier : ℚ, (state.register .total).rat? = some multiplier ∧
      ∃ later final base, index < later ∧ states[later]? = some final ∧ final.pc = labels.solveReturn ∧
        (final.register .address).nat? = some base ∧
        let table := P.cachedSolveMenuTable P.endpointCache fee multiplier P.tools P.certificate.stages
        (∀ offset < (encodeTable table).length, base + offset ∈ final.live) ∧
        heapSegment final base (encodeTable table).length = encodeTable table ∧
        time program ((states.drop index).take (later - index + 1)) ≤
          constant * (P.certificate.stages + 1) * (P.tools + 1) * (P.certificate.M + 1)

def UniformRationalImplementationClaims : Prop :=
  ∃ (prepare solver calibrate core : Program) (labels : RoutineLabels)
    (Ctime Cspace Cbits Cprepare degree : ℕ),
    0 < Ctime ∧ 0 < Cspace ∧ 0 < Cbits ∧ 0 < Cprepare ∧
    ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ), 0 ≤ fee →
      (∃ trace final, Runs prepare (rawInput P fee) trace final ∧ final.output = preparedInput P fee ∧
        time prepare trace ≤ Cprepare * (variableGammaSize P fee)^degree ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cprepare * (variableGammaSize P fee)^degree ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cprepare * (variableGammaSize P fee)^degree) ∧
      (∀ (penalty : ℚ) (n k : ℕ), ∃ trace final,
        Runs solver (solveInput P fee penalty n k) trace final ∧
        final.output = encodeTable (P.cachedSolveMenuTable P.endpointCache fee penalty k n) ∧
        time solver trace ≤ Ctime * (n + 1) * (k + 1) * (P.certificate.M + 1) ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cspace * (n + 1) * (k + 1) ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cbits * ((n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) *
          (maximumMenuBits P fee + 1) + ratEncodingBits penalty + natBits n + natBits k + 1)) ∧
      (∃ trace final, Runs calibrate (calibrationInput P) trace final ∧
        final.output = encodeList encodeCalibration (P.calibrationWeightCache P.endpointCache).toList ∧
        time calibrate trace ≤ Ctime * P.certificate.Q * (P.certificate.M + 1)^2 ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cspace * (P.certificate.M + 1) ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cbits * ((P.certificate.Q + 1) *
          (ratEncodingBits P.certificate.gamma + 2) + maximumMenuBits P fee + 1)) ∧
      ∃ trace final, Runs core (preparedInput P fee) trace final ∧
        decodeArtifact final.output = some (buildArtifact P fee) ∧
        final.output = encodeArtifact (buildArtifact P fee) ∧
        time core trace ≤ Ctime * sourceCoreScale P fee ∧
        peakCells trace ≤ Cspace * sourceRecordSpace P ∧
        peakOperandBits trace ≤ Cbits * coreOperandBound P fee ∧
        actualSolveRequests labels trace = (P.cachedSearchWithLog P.endpointCache fee (P.bisectionBudget fee)).2 ∧
        entryCount labels.solveEntry trace = (actualSolveRequests labels trace).length ∧
        entryCount labels.solveEntry trace ≤ P.bisectionBudget fee + 2 ∧
        entryCount labels.endpointEntry trace = 1 ∧ entryCount labels.calibrationEntry trace = 1 ∧
        SolverCallRefinement core labels P fee Ctime trace

bit_run_space.span_text:
abbrev BitState (states : ℕ) := Turing.TM0.Cfg Bool (Fin (states + 1))

def BitRuns {states : ℕ} (machine : BitMachine states) (input : List Bool)
    (trace : List (BitState states)) (final : BitState states) : Prop :=
  trace.head? = some (Turing.TM0.init input) ∧
    trace.IsChain (fun before after => Turing.TM0.step machine before = some after) ∧
    trace.getLast? = some final ∧ Turing.TM0.step machine final = none ∧
    final ∈ StateTransition.eval (Turing.TM0.step machine) (Turing.TM0.init input)

def headMovement {states : ℕ} (machine : BitMachine states) (state : BitState states) : ℤ :=
  match machine state.q state.Tape.head with
  | some (_, .move .left) => -1
  | some (_, .move .right) => 1
  | _ => 0

/-- Actual tape-head displacements recover visited space even though the
official TM0 configuration records a relative tape. Input cells are included. -/
def visitedBitSpace {states : ℕ} (machine : BitMachine states) (inputLength : ℕ)
    (trace : List (BitState states)) : ℕ :=
  let positions := (trace.map (headMovement machine)).scanl (· + ·) 0
  let high := positions.foldl max (inputLength : ℤ)
  let low := positions.foldl min 0
  (high - low).toNat + 1

uniform_bit.span_text:
/-- A single genuine finite-control Bool TM computes the exact fixed
frontend from RAW input, with no rational unit-cost oracle. Its actual
transition count and visited-bit space are polynomial for fixed rational
gamma and in explicit numerical 1/gamma when gamma varies. The fee's full
encoding, however small positive f is, is included in every bound.
No private-coin sampling-time bound is included in this OFFLINE target. -/
def UniformBitImplementationClaims : Prop :=

    (∀ gamma : ℚ, 0 < gamma → gamma ≤ 1 / 4 → ∃ C degree : ℕ, 0 < C ∧
      ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ), P.certificate.gamma = gamma → 0 ≤ fee →
        ∃ trace final, BitRuns machine (encodeBits (rawInput P fee)) trace final ∧
          final.Tape.right₀ = Turing.ListBlank.mk (encodeBits (encodeArtifact (buildArtifact P fee))) ∧
          trace.length ≤ C * (rawSize P fee)^degree ∧
          visitedBitSpace machine (encodeBits (rawInput P fee)).length trace ≤ C * (rawSize P fee)^degree) ∧
    ∃ C degree : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ), 0 ≤ fee →

fair_rejection.span_text:
abbrev FairTape := ℕ → Bool

noncomputable def fairTapeLaw : Measure FairTape :=
  Measure.infinitePi fun _ : ℕ => Statistics.BinarySymmetric.Parameters.fairGuessLaw

instance fairTapeLaw_probability : IsProbabilityMeasure fairTapeLaw := by
  unfold fairTapeLaw
  infer_instance

structure CoinState where
  accumulator : ℕ
  filled : ℕ
  bitsRead : ℕ
  result : Option Bool
  deriving DecidableEq

def coinInitial : CoinState := ⟨0, 0, 0, none⟩

def coinWidth (probability : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1) : ℕ := natBits probability.val.den

/-- Literal private fair-bit rejection sampler. Build an unsigned width-bit
integer; accept below the rational denominator and compare with its numerator,
otherwise restart the block. Endpoints use no bits. A rejected block consumes
its bits; there is no bounded-bit completion or rational-coin oracle. -/
def coinStep (probability : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1) (tape : FairTape) (state : CoinState) : Option CoinState :=
  if state.result.isSome then none else if probability.val = 0 then
    some { state with result := some false }
  else if probability.val = 1 then some { state with result := some true }
  else if state.filled < coinWidth probability then
    let bit := if tape state.bitsRead then 1 else 0
    some { state with
      accumulator := 2 * state.accumulator + bit
      filled := state.filled + 1
      bitsRead := state.bitsRead + 1 }
  else if state.accumulator < probability.val.den then
    some { state with result := some (decide (state.accumulator < probability.val.num.toNat)) }
  else some { state with accumulator := 0, filled := 0 }

def coinRun (probability : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1) (tape : FairTape) : ℕ → CoinState
  | 0 => coinInitial
  | steps + 1 =>
    let previous := coinRun probability tape steps
    (coinStep probability tape previous).getD previous

noncomputable def coinResult (probability : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1) (tape : FairTape) : Option Bool := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ steps, (coinRun probability tape steps).result.isSome = true
    then (coinRun probability tape (Nat.find h)).result else none

noncomputable def coinBits (probability : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1) (tape : FairTape) : ℕ∞ := by
  classical
  exact if h : ∃ steps, (coinRun probability tape steps).result.isSome = true
    then ((coinRun probability tape (Nat.find h)).bitsRead : ℕ∞) else ⊤

/-- Original D:641--642 only: ordinary private bits suffice, the sampler is
causal, nonreturn is null, and its returned law is the exact rational coin.
There is intentionally no worst-case or expected sampling-bit/time bound.
This pending theorem is not an assumption of any policy or value definition. -/
def ExactRationalCoinClaims : Prop :=
  ∀ probability : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1,
    Measurable (coinResult probability) ∧
    fairTapeLaw {tape | coinResult probability tape = none} = 0 ∧
    fairTapeLaw.map (coinResult probability) =
      (Statistics.BinarySymmetric.Parameters.rocCoinLaw (realProbability probability)).map some ∧
    ∀ (tape tape' : FairTape) (count : ℕ),
      (∀ k < count, tape k = tape' k) → coinBits probability tape ≤ (count : ℕ∞) →
        coinResult probability tape' = coinResult probability tape

abbrev CoinIndex (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) :=
  Unit ⊕ (P.sharedInstance.Stage ⊕ (P.sharedInstance.Stage × Fin (P.certificate.M + 1)))

abbrev PrivateStreams (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) := CoinIndex P → FairTape

noncomputable def privateStreamsLaw (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Measure (PrivateStreams P) :=
  Measure.pi fun _ : CoinIndex P => fairTapeLaw

instance privateStreamsLaw_probability (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : IsProbabilityMeasure (privateStreamsLaw P) := by
  unfold privateStreamsLaw
  infer_instance

def selectorProbability (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) : Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1 :=
  rationalProbability (buildArtifact P fee).selectorWeight

def calibrationProbability (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (level : Fin (P.certificate.M + 1)) :
    Set.Icc (0 : ℚ) 1 :=
  rationalProbability (P.cachedCalibrationWeight (buildArtifact P fee).frontend.calibrationWeights level.val)

noncomputable def sampledSeed (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (streams : PrivateStreams P) :
    P.CalibratedSearchSeed :=
  ((coinResult (selectorProbability P fee) (streams (.inl ()))).getD false,
    (fun stage => (coinResult (rationalProbability (1 / 2)) (streams (.inr (.inl stage)))).getD false),
    fun stage level => (coinResult (calibrationProbability P fee level) (streams (.inr (.inr (stage, level))))).getD false)

def seedSamplerReturns (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (streams : PrivateStreams P) : Prop :=
  (coinResult (selectorProbability P fee) (streams (.inl ()))).isSome = true ∧
    (∀ stage, (coinResult (rationalProbability (1 / 2)) (streams (.inr (.inl stage)))).isSome = true) ∧
    ∀ stage level, (coinResult (calibrationProbability P fee level) (streams (.inr (.inr (stage, level))))).isSome = true

/-- Actual finite-family sampler for THIS cached algorithm's whole-policy
selector, fair stage bits and independent stage/level marks. It receives only
private fair tapes, no Native.World and no observation/correction interface.
The default on a nonreturned coin is only an explicit total completion; its
exceptional event must be proved null, not silently deleted from native fees.
This is a seed-law identity, not a new delta-safety or cost guarantee. -/
def PrivateSeedSamplingClaims : Prop :=
  ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ), 0 ≤ fee →
    Measurable (sampledSeed P fee) ∧
    privateStreamsLaw P {streams | ¬ seedSamplerReturns P fee streams} = 0 ∧
    (privateStreamsLaw P).map (sampledSeed P fee) = P.cachedAlgorithmSeedLaw fee

menu_encoding.span_text:
/-- Standard binary length, with one bit allotted to zero. These are
encoding sizes of concrete rationals, not a claim about Lean object layout. -/
def natBits (n : ℕ) : ℕ := Nat.log2 n + 1

def ratDenBits (q : ℚ) : ℕ := natBits q.den
def ratNumBits (q : ℚ) : ℕ := natBits q.num.natAbs
def ratEncodingBits (q : ℚ) : ℕ := 1 + ratNumBits q + ratDenBits q

def menuScalars (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) : List ℚ :=
  P.endpointCache.toList.flatMap (fun endpoint => [endpoint.error, endpoint.charge]) ++ [P.reviewFee, fee]

def menuCommonDenominator (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  ((P.menuScalars fee).map Rat.den).prod

def MenuEncodingBound (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) (L : ℕ) : Prop :=
  1 ≤ L ∧ ∀ scalar ∈ P.menuScalars fee, ratEncodingBits scalar ≤ L

/-- Original D:623--627, with the actual cached table fields and the
explicit common denominator. Multiplier bits enter objective records;
there is no assumption of endpoint optimality or a policy-cost bound. -/
def MenuBitClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee penalty : ℚ) (L : ℕ), P.MenuEncodingBound fee L →
    natBits (P.menuCommonDenominator fee) ≤ (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
    ∀ n : ℕ, n ≤ P.certificate.stages → ∀ k : ℕ, k ≤ P.tools →
      let entry := menuEntryAt (P.cachedSolveMenuTable P.endpointCache fee penalty P.tools P.certificate.stages) n k
      entry.observation.den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^n ∧
      entry.repairs.den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^n ∧
      entry.failure.den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^n ∧
      (entry.objective fee penalty).den ∣ (P.menuCommonDenominator fee)^(n + 1) * penalty.den ∧
      ratDenBits entry.observation ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
      ratDenBits entry.repairs ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
      ratDenBits entry.failure ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L ∧
      ratDenBits (entry.objective fee penalty) ≤ (n + 1) * (2 * (P.certificate.M + 1) + 2) * L + ratDenBits penalty ∧
      (∀ scalar ∈ [entry.observation, entry.repairs, entry.failure, entry.objective fee penalty],
        ratNumBits scalar ≤ ratDenBits scalar + natBits (⌈|scalar|⌉₊ + 1) +
          natBits P.certificate.stages + natBits P.tools + 2)

/-- A common denominator for BOTH rational BSC letters. The public
gamma, not any sampled hidden bit, determines this constant. -/
def channelCommonDenominator (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : ℕ := 2 * P.certificate.gamma.den

/-- Original D:628--629. Exact q_m/omega_m values are those in the
independent array cache. The fixed Q dominates the endpoint levels; no
new asymptotic relation or successful-path restriction is a premise. -/
def CalibrationBitClaims : Prop :=
  ∃ C : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (Lgamma : ℕ), ratEncodingBits P.certificate.gamma ≤ Lgamma →
    ∀ m : ℕ, m ≤ P.certificate.M →
      (P.cachedCappedError m).den ∣ 2 * P.channelCommonDenominator^P.certificate.Q ∧
      ratDenBits (P.cachedCappedError m) ≤ C * (P.certificate.Q + 1) * (Lgamma + 2) ∧
      ratDenBits (P.cachedCalibrationWeight (P.calibrationWeightCache P.endpointCache) m) ≤
        C * (P.certificate.Q + 1) * (Lgamma + 2) ∧
      ratEncodingBits (P.cachedCalibrationWeight (P.calibrationWeightCache P.endpointCache) m) ≤
        C * (P.certificate.Q + 1) * (Lgamma + 2)

rational endpoint risks has a linear encoding-size bound in its operands,
including their numerators. It does not create an exponential bit tree. -/

/-- Original D:633--636. Tiny positive f is counted by its own full
rational encoding; neither f nor zeta_f-delta is treated as a unit-cost oracle. -/
def PositiveGapBitClaims (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) : Prop :=
  ∀ (fee : ℚ), 0 ≤ fee →
    ratEncodingBits (P.firstChargeFloor fee) ≤ ratEncodingBits P.reviewFee + ratEncodingBits fee ∧
    (P.certificate.risk < P.zeroChargeRisk fee →
      1 / ((2 : ℚ)^P.certificate.stages * (P.certificate.risk.den : ℚ)) ≤
        P.zeroChargeRisk fee - P.certificate.risk ∧
      Real.log (((P.zeroChargeRisk fee - P.certificate.risk : ℚ) : ℝ)⁻¹) ≤
        (P.certificate.stages : ℝ) * Real.log 2 + Real.log (P.certificate.risk.den : ℝ))

def menuActionBits : MenuAction → ℕ
  | .finish | .abandon => 2
  | .test level _ => 3 + natBits level

def menuEntryBits (entry : MenuEntry) : ℕ := menuActionBits entry.action +
  ratEncodingBits entry.observation + ratEncodingBits entry.repairs + ratEncodingBits entry.failure

def menuTableBits (table : MenuTable) : ℕ :=
  (table.toList.map (fun row => (row.toList.map menuEntryBits).sum)).sum

def solveBits (solution : MultiplierSolve) : ℕ := ratEncodingBits solution.multiplier + menuTableBits solution.table

def stateBits : MultiplierState → ℕ
  | .exact solution => 1 + solveBits solution
  | .bracket lower upper => 1 + solveBits lower + solveBits upper

def frontendBits (frontend : CachedFrontend) : ℕ :=
  (frontend.endpoints.toList.map (fun endpoint => ratEncodingBits endpoint.error + ratEncodingBits endpoint.charge)).sum +
    (frontend.calibrationWeights.toList.map (fun calibration => ratEncodingBits calibration.error + ratEncodingBits calibration.weight)).sum +
      stateBits frontend.state

def numericalSize (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ) : ℕ :=
  P.certificate.t0 + P.certificate.M + P.certificate.Q + P.bisectionBudget fee + frontendBits (P.buildCachedFrontend fee)

/-- The data-size part of D:637--640. These are exact polynomial targets
for the existing fixed functions, not an existential replacement program.
No claim about RAM/bit running time or a private-coin sampler is included. -/
def FixedGammaPolynomialData (gamma : ℚ) : Prop :=
  ∃ C degree : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ),
    P.certificate.gamma = gamma → 0 ≤ fee →
      P.numericalSize fee ≤ C * (P.certificate.stages + ratEncodingBits P.certificate.risk +
        ratEncodingBits P.reviewFee + ratEncodingBits fee + 1)^degree

def VariableGammaPolynomialData : Prop :=
  ∃ C degree : ℕ, 0 < C ∧ ∀ (P : PaperProofs.Paid.Parameters) (fee : ℚ), 0 ≤ fee →
    P.numericalSize fee ≤ C * (P.certificate.stages + ratEncodingBits P.certificate.gamma +
      ratEncodingBits P.certificate.risk + ratEncodingBits P.reviewFee + ratEncodingBits fee +
        ⌈P.certificate.gamma⁻¹⌉₊ + 1)^degree

same_fixed_bool_actual_proof.span_text:
/-- ORIGINAL claim, as SOURCE ONLY pending parent Lean validation and
the final public/private-origin audit. The real eight-phase source
producer discharges all intermediate simulation premises. A single
fixed Bool machine and common constants precede every gamma/P/fee;
the same once-selected bit run supplies exact output, time and space. -/
theorem uniform_bit_implementation_claims : UniformBitImplementationClaims := by
  classical
  obtain ⟨prepareCode, coreCode, sourceC, sourceD, _sourcePositive, sourceRuns⟩ :=
    Phases.Original.original_source ISA.fixedRatBackend
  let source := Phases.program ISA.fixedRatBackend prepareCode coreCode
  have closed := Phases.supports ISA.fixedRatBackend prepareCode coreCode
  obtain ⟨states, machine, backendC, _backendPositive, compiled⟩ :=
    Backend.uniform_original_raw_backend_polynomial source closed
  let A := backendC * (sourceC + 25)^2
  let degree := (sourceD + 1) * 2
  apply PDROC.BitVM.Size.claims_of_variable states machine (2 * A + 25) degree (by omega)
  intro P fee nonnegative
  obtain ⟨sourceTrace, sourceFinal, first, chain, last, halt, output, sourceTime⟩ :=
    sourceRuns P fee nonnegative
  have nonempty : 0 < (sourceFinal.stk (0 : ISA.Stack)).length := by
    rw [output]
    exact List.length_pos_iff_ne_nil.mpr (Phases.encoded_nonempty _)
  obtain ⟨trace, final, actual, naked, clock, space, _prefixSpace⟩ :=
    compiled P fee sourceTrace sourceFinal first chain last halt nonempty
  let S := variableGammaSize P fee
  have sizePositive : 1 ≤ S := PDROC.BitVM.Size.variable_positive P fee
  have rawLength : (encodeBits (rawInput P fee)).length ≤ 24 * S :=
    PDROC.BitVM.Size.raw_input_length P fee
  have combined := source_sum_bound sourceC sourceD (encodeBits (rawInput P fee)).length
    sourceTrace.length S sizePositive rawLength sourceTime
  have backendTime : backendC * ((encodeBits (rawInput P fee)).length + sourceTrace.length + 1)^2 ≤
      A * S^degree := by
    simpa only [A, degree, mul_pow, ← pow_mul, Nat.mul_assoc] using
      Nat.mul_le_mul_left backendC (Nat.pow_le_pow_left combined 2)
  have liftSize : S ≤ S^degree := by
    have enough : 1 ≤ degree := by dsimp only [degree]; omega
    simpa only [pow_one] using Nat.pow_le_pow_right sizePositive enough
  have liftRaw : (encodeBits (rawInput P fee)).length ≤ 24 * S^degree :=
    rawLength.trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 24 liftSize)
  have liftOne : 1 ≤ S^degree := sizePositive.trans liftSize
  have coefficient : A ≤ 2 * A + 25 := by omega
  have clockBound : trace.length ≤ (2 * A + 25) * S^degree :=
    (clock.trans backendTime).trans (Nat.mul_le_mul_right _ coefficient)
  have spaceBound : visitedBitSpace machine (encodeBits (rawInput P fee)).length trace ≤
      (2 * A + 25) * S^degree := by
    apply space.trans
    calc
      _ ≤ 24 * S^degree + 2 * (A * S^degree) + S^degree :=
        Nat.add_le_add (Nat.add_le_add liftRaw (Nat.mul_le_mul_left 2 backendTime)) liftOne
      _ = (2 * A + 25) * S^degree := by ring
  have exactOutput : final.Tape.right₀ = ListBlank.mk (encodeBits (encodeArtifact (buildArtifact P fee))) := by

# Batch012 original scope under review

This batch accepts the complete original D27 computation claim. The exact no-argument formal theorem, all seven ordinary public consumers, normal wrapper/root builds, full current build, formal1920-module axiom audit, complete1956-origin frozen audits and every external source/object/evidence byte guard actually passed. The accepted count is250/253; A19/B23/L01 and whole-manuscript S7 remain open. The final receipt explicitly binds the ledger-only acceptance transition to the identical already-audited mathematical source and proof assets.

| Frozen original text | Original Lean obligation | Completed frozen proof scope |
|---|---|---|
| paid-proofs.tex:614–621 | `UniformRationalImplementationClaims` | The same fixed prepare/solver/calibrate/core and routine labels precede every original P/fee. Raw6 actually produces prepared13. Every solver table, actual RAM run, numerical operation bound, peak live records and intermediate operand bits are proved, including arbitrary solver n/k/penalty. The core retains the original cached artifact, exact solve requests, at most Jbis+2 solver calls, one endpoint phase and one calibration, with actual call refinement. |

Fee zero and arbitrarily small positive fee retain their original encoding costs. This component was already formally accepted as D27b. |
| paid-proofs.tex:637–640 | `UniformBitImplementationClaims` | One finite-control Bool machine precedes gamma/P/fee. It starts from the exact original raw encoding and physically computes the bare original artifact at actual HALT. Fixed rational gamma gives the original rawSize polynomial; variable gamma uses the original explicit numerical inverse-gamma scale. Both time and visited-bit space concern that same actual trace. No logarithmic-in-inverse-gamma promise is added. |
| paid-proofs.tex:641–642 | `ExactRationalCoinClaims` and `PrivateSeedSamplingClaims` | Actual fair-bit rejection is causal, almost surely returns and has the exact rational coin law. The full finite-family private seed has the exact original joint law. No native observation/correction interface or bounded worst-case/expected sampling-time claim is introduced. These components were already formally accepted in006. |
| Literal implementation interfaces supporting the preceding guarantees | `CodecClaims` and `CodeRefinementClaims` | Exact five-word instruction codec, readonly physical fetch/PC, typed-to-word actual run and cost refinement. These already accepted components remain conclusions of the full seven-field package. |

The no-argument frozen theorem is
`RootD27.Core.CanonicalCapsule.computationalClaims :
PaperProofs.Paid.Computation.ComputationalClaims`, from the actual normally
compiled module `RootD27Core_CanonicalCapsule_ActualFull_004`. It proves all
seven conjuncts; no caller-supplied implementation, source trace, numerical
resource, width, prepared-input, termination, randomness or performance
premise remains. Original fee/nonnegative and certificate qualifications are
unchanged. Uniformity is preserved: programs and constants are not selected
after individual original inputs.

The accepted ordinary formal theorem is
`PDCompute.computationalClaims`, minimum import
`PaperProofs.Paid.PDCompute_Complete_001`, with exactly that original type.
It consumes the frozen theorem through an ordinary private import. The
original `ComputationalClaims` definition and all seven fields are unchanged.

The frozen implementation preserves all 1956 actual source-module identities.
There are 1815 private dependency sources and 141 existing formal source
origins. Each origin has one exact selected source pin and one same-name
five-product binding; no olean is renamed to another module identity. Runtime
proofs are not recompiled merely to move them under a different source prefix.
The registered local proof package retains every private source and the real
original products, without a partial `PaperProofs` directory that could shadow
the complete ordinary project.

Actual owner coverage is checked by the union of the frozen original numeric,
Bool, arithmetic, capsule and formal audits, plus the new actual audit of the
remaining 380 Common/Structure origins. Each collector uses real `import all`
private data and original module ownership, including unused private and

outside `propext`, `Classical.choice`, `Quot.sound`. An import inventory is not
substituted for a collector's actual owner set. These separate coherent audit
views are recorded separately; no flattened fresh all-ancestor audit is claimed.

Normal Lake was experimentally verified to load a registered local prebuilt
package and compile only a new consumer. It does not automatically track the
external product bytes. Formal verification must therefore validate the full
source/object/configuration/audit provenance manifest before and after every
acceptance build/audit and bind it into the official receipt. Missing or changed
assets are a hard failure. The normal full `--no-build` check is supplementary
and cannot replace that guard. The fallback canonical source-promotion plan is
preserved unchanged.

All new Lean invocations remain under the two-slot Recovery2 gate, `-M2048`,
`autoImplicit=false`, `warningAsError=true`, `Elab.async=false`. Old accepted
proofs and original frozen manuscript are unchanged. No Paid dependency enters
the independent A19/B23/L01 main chain. Only after actual successful formal
acceptance may D27 become closed and the count become 250/253. Remaining main
targets A19/B23/L01 and whole-manuscript S7 continue.
